mapper.select:
select count(id) as totalCount, sum(amount) as totalAmount from orders
and status = #{status}

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(orderDate ORDER BY orderDate SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(turnover ORDER BY orderDate SEPARATOR ',') AS turnoverList FROM ( SELECT DATE(order_time) AS orderDate, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS turnover FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{beginTime} AND order_time <= DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status = 5 GROUP BY DATE(order_time) ) AS daily_stats;

select GROUP_CONCAT(orderDate ORDER BY orderDate SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(orderCount ORDER BY orderDate SEPARATOR ',') AS orderCountList, GROUP_CONCAT(validOrderCount ORDER BY orderDate SEPARATOR ',') AS validOrderCountList, SUM(orderCount) AS totalOrderCount, SUM(validOrderCount) AS validOrderCount, ROUND(SUM(validOrderCount) / SUM(orderCount), 2) AS orderCompletionRate from ( select DATE(order_time) AS orderDate, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(IF(status = 5, 1, 0)) AS validOrderCount from orders where order_time >= #{beginTime} and order_time <= DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by DATE(order_time) )AS daily_stats;

select GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY number DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS nameList, GROUP_CONCAT(number ORDER BY number DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS numberList from ( select od.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS number from orders o left join order_detail od on o.id = od.order_id where o.order_time >= #{beginTime} and o.order_time <= DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by od.name )AS daily_stats;

select count(*) as allOrders, sum(case when status = 6 then 1 else 0 end) as cancelledOrders, sum(case when status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as completedOrders, sum(case when status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as deliveredOrders, sum(case when status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as waitingOrders from orders
